ticket.title: Bulk action to mark selected invoices as paid in the invoice list
ticket.description: Accountants currently mark invoices as paid one by one after every bank import, which is slow. The speaker requests a bulk Mark as paid action for invoices selected in the invoice list.

feature.userNeed: Accountants mark invoices as paid one by one after every bank import, and it takes a long time.
feature.proposedBehavior: In the invoice list, users select several invoices with the checkboxes. As soon as at least one is selected, a Mark as paid button appears. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog showing how many invoices will be changed. The paid date is set to today by default. Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoice list has checkboxes that allow selecting several invoices.
A button called Mark as paid appears as soon as at least one invoice is selected.
Clicking Mark as paid opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed.
The paid date is set to today by default.
Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.

ticket.title: Add dark mode toggle in user menu for Ledgerly
ticket.description: Users working late in the evening find the white screen hard on the eyes. The speaker wants a dark mode that can be switched on and off from the user menu and is remembered at the next login.

feature.userNeed: Users who work late in the evening find the white screen hard on the eyes.
feature.proposedBehavior: Add a switch in the user menu to turn dark mode on and off. The app remembers the user's choice the next time they log in.
acceptanceCriteria: The user menu contains a switch to turn dark mode on and off.
After the user chooses a mode, the app uses that mode at the next login.
